cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Bring Back Everything
cards.instruction: Return early details in altered forms until the scene feels like it has been building toward one unavoidable consequence.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Put the cake on that spare chair. I'll keep the table clear until everyone has sat down.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That leaves one guest without a seat.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Give the guest the piano stool. I'll ask the pianist to stand until it's time for the birthday song.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's time for the song now. The guest has moved the cake onto the table and taken the chair, so the pianist can sit.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll cut the cake when the song ends. My clear table has become the serving table, and the spare chair has decided when we're having dessert.

reason: Make B restore piano stool and guest chair by moving cake to the explicitly established table; A original delay collapses into serving dessert after current song, with every placement coherent.
